snippet.title: Ancient Farm | XBOX Trailer
snippet.description:
🌾 Build your farm in the land of the pharaohs: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/ancient-farm/9pgn1ljjc210

Check out Ancient Farm, arriving on Xbox Series X|S on September 24, 2026!

Start with a small plot of land and grow your farm in ancient Egypt. Plant crops, raise animals, and work with tools from the time of the pharaohs. Gather resources, build, craft, and cook as you settle into a relaxing farming life. Plan around changing seasons and market prices, and turn your first harvest into a thriving farm, all at your own pace.

#AncientFarm #FarmingSimulator #IndieGame
